## Summary

Describe the motivation and user-visible or internal change.

## Validation

- [ ] `cargo fmt --check`
- [ ] `cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings`
- [ ] `cargo test --locked`
- [ ] `cargo test --release --locked` (when practical; required before release)
- [ ] Documentation, changelog, compatibility notes, and security implications updated where relevant

## Review notes

Call out any limitations, migration concerns, or follow-up work. Do not include credentials or private repository data.
